MODEL_FEEDBACK_JSON:
{
  "positive_alignment_reasons": [
    "Construction adhesive felt relevant because it could support the kinds of wood fastening and mounting jobs suggested by my recent screws and wall anchors.",
    "That adhesive recommendation recognized a possible related need, although I would need a specific project before choosing six cartridges."
  ],
  "negative_misalignment_reasons": [
    "Lock nuts look related to my fastener purchases, but they require matching bolts; buying nails and wood screws does not mean I need nuts.",
    "Hose clamps, a tube brush, metal cutting wheels and a leg dolly serve tasks I have not shown a need for.",
    "Tape, epoxy and oil could be useful someday, but general usefulness is not enough for me to choose them now."
  ],
  "overgeneralized_signals": [
    "My interest in nails, screws and anchors seemed to be stretched into an interest in almost any workshop or repair supply.",
    "Items used around repairs seemed to be treated as interchangeable even when they solve very different problems."
  ],
  "missing_or_underweighted_signals": [
    "My repeated nail and wood screw choices point more specifically toward fastening wood and mounting things than toward metalwork or equipment maintenance.",
    "Exact fit matters: nail angle and dimensions, screw size, and matching threads or hose diameters determine whether a supply is useful to me.",
    "I choose supplies when they fit a current need; even the relevant adhesive is only a tentative match because the six-cartridge quantity needs a clear use."
  ],
  "summary_diagnosis": "The recommendations partly recognized my fastening needs but broadened them into general repair interests without enough evidence of a current use."
}
